summary: Iteration 68 — viewport/bbox-driven Catholic World Map. Backend: 10/10 tests pass for the new GET /api/sites/bbox endpoint (auth, world-view-curated-only osm_count=0, Rome zoom=12 yields osm_count>50 with items within snapped bounds, repeat-call caching gives identical results and is not slower, London & Paris return real OSM churches, span-guard for a huge bbox at zoom=12 returns osm_count=0 quickly) plus full regression on /api/sites (270 curated), /api/sites/nearby (featured relic-bearing site + nearby_churches[]) and /api/sites/lourdes. Frontend: /community/map renders, the featured 'A holy place to explore — Valencia Cathedral / Relics to venerate here' card shows, the list toggle works, and the Leaflet iframe receives all 270 curated markers via postMessage (270 .leaflet-marker-icon nodes counted on the world view). HOWEVER the new 'Zoom in to reveal every Catholic church in view' hint text is NOT rendered in the DOM at all — document.body.innerText, querySelectorAll text search, and iframe content all confirm the string is missing despite being present at map.tsx:341. Deep-zoom interaction inside the Leaflet srcdoc iframe could not be automated (no exposed map handle); per spec this is not a failure, but it means the live /api/sites/bbox call at zoom>=9 was not triggered through the UI in this run — backend bbox behaviour was verified directly via pytest instead. No React Native red screen, no console errors, no deprecated-package usage on this screen.

ui_bugs.issue: The new prompt 'Zoom in to reveal every Catholic church in view' is completely missing from the rendered output. Verified by (a) get_by_text wait timing out, (b) document.body.innerText scan, (c) querySelectorAll textContent scan, and (d) iframe content scan — none contain 'Zoom' or 'reveal'. The legend immediately below it renders normally, so mapWrap is mounted. Likely cause: the absolutely-positioned <Text style={styles.zoomHint}> with alignSelf:'center' + overflow:'hidden' and no explicit width collapses to 0 in react-native-web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/community/map.tsx:341 and styles.zoomHint at :499.

issues: Zoom hint pill missing as above — users on a world view get no guidance that zooming in unlocks every church in view, which is the headline feature of this iteration.

action_items: Fix the missing zoom hint in /app/frontend/app/community/map.tsx:341 — wrap the <Text> in a <View style={{position:'absolute', top:8, left:0, right:0, alignItems:'center'}}> and make the Text itself a non-absolute pill, OR set explicit width/maxWidth on styles.zoomHint and drop alignSelf. Also add testID='map-zoom-hint' so future automation can assert it.
Optionally expose the Leaflet map handle (e.g., window.__leafletMap = map) inside mapHtml.ts so Playwright can drive zoom/pan and exercise /api/sites/bbox end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: catholic_sites.py is 1727 lines and contains the seed data, Overpass clients, both /nearby and /bbox routes, and helper utilities. Consider splitting into catholic_sites_data.py (SEED_SITES), catholic_sites_osm.py (Overpass + cache), and catholic_sites_router.py — file size threshold for review is 700 lines.

/api/sites/bbox response is hard-capped at 1200 markers (markers[:1200]) but the cap is silent. Consider returning a 'truncated': true flag so the UI can hint the user to zoom further when their viewport hits the cap.

_osm_bbox_churches snaps bbox to 0.1deg which makes the cache effective but means returned points can fall slightly outside the requested bbox (verified — Rome call at south=41.85 returned a point at lat=41.7998). UI should be aware; tests now use 0.15deg of slack.

rca_of_issue: Zoom hint missing — Reproduction: open /community/map with mobile viewport 390x844, wait 8s, inspect document.body.innerText: the string 'Zoom in to reveal' is absent. RCA: <Text style={styles.zoomHint}> at map.tsx:341 uses {position:'absolute', top:8, alignSelf:'center', overflow:'hidden'} with no width/maxWidth. In react-native-web, an absolutely-positioned RNText with alignSelf and overflow:hidden but no measured width can collapse and be culled from layout. Mitigation: wrap in a centring container OR set width/maxWidth on the Text and remove alignSelf.
